lines.en: Ximena, before you send that email to the client, let me read the first lines.
lines.pt: Ximena, antes de enviar esse e-mail ao cliente, deixe-me ler as primeiras linhas.

lines.en: I am writing to ask whether the delivery could be moved to next Friday. Is that too direct?
lines.pt: Estou escrevendo para perguntar se a entrega poderia ser adiada para a próxima sexta. Isso é direto demais?

lines.en: It is clear, but I would soften it. Try: I was wondering if it would be possible to move it.
lines.pt: É claro, mas eu suavizaria. Tente: Eu estava me perguntando se seria possível adiar.

lines.en: That sounds better. Then I will add that I would appreciate it if they could confirm quickly.
lines.pt: Soa melhor. Então vou acrescentar que eu agradeceria se eles pudessem confirmar logo.

lines.en: Good. Also, would you mind attaching the updated schedule? Clients rarely read long paragraphs.
lines.pt: Bom. Além disso, você se importaria de anexar o cronograma atualizado? Clientes raramente leem parágrafos longos.

lines.en: Of course. I have attached it, and I will mention it so that nobody misses the file.
lines.pt: Claro. Já anexei, e vou mencionar isso para que ninguém deixe de ver o arquivo.

lines.en: Nice. How will you end? Avoid sounding demanding, even if the deadline is tight.
lines.pt: Legal. Como vai terminar? Evite parecer exigente, mesmo que o prazo seja apertado.

lines.en: I look forward to hearing from you, and thank you in advance for your understanding.
lines.pt: Aguardo o seu retorno e agradeço desde já pela compreensão.

lines.en: Excellent. Remember to check the tone, the spelling and the name of the person before sending.
lines.pt: Excelente. Lembre-se de conferir o tom, a ortografia e o nome da pessoa antes de enviar.

lines.en: I always double-check the name. Last month I wrote Mr instead of Ms and felt embarrassed.
lines.pt: Eu sempre confiro o nome. No mês passado escrevi Sr. em vez de Sra. e fiquei envergonhada.

lines.en: It happens to everyone. Send it now, and let me know when they reply.
lines.pt: Acontece com todo mundo. Envie agora e me avise quando eles responderem.

words.ex: To soften is to make something less hard.
A demanding person asks for a lot.
A deadline is the last day for a task.
To attach is to add a file to an email.
The tone shows how you sound.

teach.goal: Ponte português → inglês com palavras úteis.
solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.
group: Palavras: soften, demanding, deadline, attach, tone, embarrassed.
Aluno diz em português um uso real, depois a palavra em inglês.
extra90: Cada aluno escolhe a palavra mais útil e explica por quê.

facts.big: Would you mind + -ing · I would appreciate it if… · look forward to + -ing
facts.label: E-mail educado
facts.sub: Pedir: Would you mind attaching…? Suavizar: I was wondering if… Formal: I would appreciate it if… Fechar: I look forward to hearing from you.

facts.label: Would you mind…?
facts.sub: Use Would you mind + -ing para pedir um favor: Would you mind attaching the file? Para algo mais formal, use I would appreciate it if you could…. Evite ordens diretas como Send me the file.

facts.label: I was wondering if…
facts.sub: Use I was wondering if… ou it would be possible to… para suavizar um pedido ou más notícias. O passado e o would deixam a frase mais indireta e mais educada, sem perder clareza.

compare.br: Em português, dizemos “você poderia…?” e “agradeço desde já”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I was wondering if… is a soft way to ask.
Would you mind + -ing is a polite request.
I would appreciate it if you could… is informal.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I was wondering if… is a soft way to ask. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Would you mind + -ing is a polite request. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
I would appreciate it if you could… is informal. → Falso (It is formal and polite.)

pages.title: Writing a polite email · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet afternoon in an Austin office, and the air conditioning hums. Lia has to write to an important client about a delay. She knows the news is not good. Her colleague Finn has years of experience with clients. He offers to read her draft before she sends it. They sit side by side in front of the screen.

“Lia, before you send that email to the client, let me read the first lines.” says Finn. “I am writing to ask whether the delivery could be moved to next Friday. Is that too direct?” says Lia. “It is clear, but I would soften it. Try: I was wondering if it would be possible to move it.” says Finn.
